page.layout: One page of text, single column; a heading at the top, the body of the dedication below it, a centred closing block, and a catchword-style running title "PRÆFA-" at the lower text position. No margin notes, no page number.

main_text.head: NVNCVPATORIA.
main_text.p: uires & efficaciam, ad succurrendum ecclesijs Germaniæ, quùm reformandis, tum pacandis: simulque donet Celsitudini tuæ, uitæ longævitatem: & in omni principatu tuo ueram pietatem, cum solida ac diuturna pace coniunctam. Bernæ Eluetiorum: Anno ab incarnatione Seruatoris nostri, Millesimo quingentesimo & sexagesimo.

page.notes: The first line of the text is partly damaged at its left edge ("uires" may be "uires" with a worn initial). The heading "NVNCVPATORIA." is set in spaced capitals. The closing block "PRÆFA-" is set in spaced capitals with a hyphen. Stains on the page are not transcribed.
